results.evidence_text: amount of saturated and polyunsaturated fat consumption of patients with prostatic carcinoma and controls
results.manual_review_reason: Abstract states PUFA was assessed in cases vs controls but reports only a total-fat null result; PUFA-specific estimate may exist only in full text, and cancer ascertainment was screen-based.
results.one_sentence_explanation: The abstract states polyunsaturated fat consumption was separately assessed in prostatic carcinoma cases versus controls in a prospective incidence study, so no exclusion code is clearly established and Claude+Gemini's ELIGIBLE_NOT_POOLABLE (INCLUDE) is supported over ChatGPT's S2-NO-TARGET-ESTIMATE.
